# dsh-desktop-notify
English | 中文
Native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: permission requests can be answered directly from
the system notification (Reject / Allow once), and turn completion, questions and errors can raise
reminders; notification sounds support system sounds, a built-in chime, custom audio and silence.
## Features
- **Cross-platform native notifications**: Windows (WinRT toast + `dshnotify:` protocol callback), m

acOS (terminal-notifier), Linux (`notify-send`).
- **Inline notification buttons**: permission notif
ications carry Reject and Allow once; clicking returns the decision to the Host's `approval/request`

waterfall.
- **Foreground fallback**: by default the plugin takes over only while the window is not
focused; when the window is focused, the user returns, or the notification times out, the request f

alls back to DSH's native approval panel.
- **Other reminders**: questions, turn completion and sess

ion errors; each switchable and optionally limited to the background.
- **Away detection**: a focuse
d window with no keyboard or pointer input for the configured number of seconds counts as away (defa

ult 180 s, 0 disables).
- **Session titles**: notification bodies prefer the session title and fall

back to the working directory name.
- **Bell entry**: the Notifications settings section uses a bell
icon (0.2.2+ uses the native `settings.section.icon`; 0.2.0/0.2.1 use a DOM patch that silently fal

ls back to the default gear if the structure changes).
- **Custom notification sound**: `system` / `

bundled` / `custom` / `none`, previewable in settings.
- **Interaction cue**: approvals and question
s (including plan prompts) play a separate cue, **configured independently from the notification sou
nd** and **regardless of window focus** — it plays even while the window is focused; also supports `

bundled` / `custom` / `none` and preview.
- **Reusable service**: the Host registers `ctx.desktopNot

ify`; other plugins can call `show()` to display a notification with buttons.
- **Windows notificati
on identity**: automatically reads the AppUserModelID of the installed `DeepSeek Harness.lnk`, so th
e toast header shows "DeepSeek Harness" and the application icon; falls back to a manually configure

d AUMID only when detection fails.
- **Windows protocol repair**: the settings page can re-register
the `dshnotify:` protocol and open the system notification settings after confirmation.
## Platform support
| Capability | Windows | macOS | Linux |

| Notification display | WinRT toast (PowerShell) | terminal-notifier | `notify-send` |
| Inline but
tons | Yes (`dshnotify:` protocol + VBS) | Yes | needs libnotify 0.7.10+ and a daemon with actions |

| Click callback | VBS writes a rendezvous JSON | stdout | `notify-send -A` |
| System sound | toas
t `<audio ms-winsoundevent:...>` | system sound names (Bottle, etc.) | `canberra-gtk-play`, best eff

insoundevent:...>` | system sound names (Bottle, etc.) | `canberra-gtk-play`, best effort |
[该节后续省略]
## DSH compatibility
DSH currently ships as release candidates (`0.2.0-rc.x`, `0.2.1-rc.x`, `0.2.2-rc.x`); this plugin wa
s audited and adapted against **0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1**, covering the intermediate RC
| DSH | Settings nav icon | Config form | Notifications/approvals |

| 0.2.2-rc.1 | native `settings.section.icon` | `configForms` + `volatile` fields | unchanged |
| 0.

2.1-rc.5 / 0.2.1-rc.4 | DOM patch | `configForms` + `volatile` fields | unchanged |
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | D
OM patch | `configForms` + `volatile` fields | unchanged |
Adaptation notes:
- Peer ranges were widened to `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.0` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery ^3.18.0`, c
overing cordis `~4.0.4` / schemastery `~3.18.4` in 0.2.0 and cordis `~4.1.0` / schemastery `~3.19.0`

in 0.2.2.
- `approval/request` and its result vocabulary, `user-questions/request`, `agent/status|e
rror|disposed`, `sessionTitle.get`, `connection.requestRejection`, `typertGateway.hasLiveClient`, `c
onfigForms.get/mutate/whileServed`, `settings.section` and volatile form filtering were checked agai

nst all three versions.
- `displayReason` is a localized `{ en, zh, ... }` object in 0.2.x (not a st

ring); the plugin picks the value for the current UI language.
- 0.2.2 adds the `settings.section.ic
on` slot; 0.2.0/0.2.1 do not have it, so the plugin falls back to its DOM patch and all three versio

ns show the bell.
- `configForms` is injected optionally: when a composition does not provide it, no
tifications, approvals and presence keep working; only the settings page is absent.
## Architecture
- **Host plugin** (`index.js`): registers the Cordis Service `desktopNotify`; listens for `approval/
request` (`prepend + global`), `user-questions/request`, `agent/status` and `agent/error`; Windows u
ses `lib/winrt.js` (WinRT toast + protocol callback + `assets/resolve-aumid.ps1` for the notificatio
n identity), macOS/Linux use `lib/notifier.js` (node-notifier); `lib/sound.js` plays the notificatio
n sound and the interaction cue (two independent `SoundPlayer` instances); `lib/presence.js` tracks
multi-window focus. The interaction cue plays when `approval/request` and `user-questions/request` a

rrive, without checking focus.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- macOS notifications cannot be branded as DeepSeek Harness (third-party notifier limitation).
- Win
dows uses WinRT plus a custom protocol; the first registration writes `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshnoti

fy`. If security software blocks `wscript.exe`, button callbacks are unavailable.
- Windows custom a

udio only supports WAV; system sound names must start with `Notification.`.
- Action labels are sani
tized (`,`, `;` and a leading `-` are removed; max 24 characters); action ids keep only letters, dig

its, `_` and `-`; at most 3 buttons.
- Concurrent approvals: only one is taken over; the rest go to

the in-app panel.
- Bell icon: 0.2.2+ uses the native slot; 0.2.0/0.2.1 use a DOM patch and silently
fall back to the default gear if DSH changes the settings structure; notifications are unaffected.
- Idle detection starts when the page loads; if the page just loaded and the user is already away, t

he first reminder can be up to one threshold (default 180 s) late.
- Configuration changes reload th
e Host plugin; in-flight notifications are closed and pending approvals are delegated back to the pa

nel.
- No notification center/history; nothing is re-sent after the app quits.
